name: Casimir Boateng-Zhdanov
description:
Casimir is built like he was designed for a different neighborhood and ended up here — broad through the shoulders for his age, with his Ghanaian grandfather's deep-set eyes and his Belarusian grandmother's unexpectedly sharp nose, and skin the color of dark polished teak. He has retractable claw mods on his right hand, cheap gray-market work that catches and sticks sometimes and leaves small gouges in every surface he rests his fingers on. His left ear has a long cosmetic antenna mod — a thin chrome filament that curves up past the ear's edge — which he got because the Iron Bend crew's older members have them and he wanted in on the aesthetic before he was officially in anything.

He is a prospect for the Iron Bend Substrates, a mid-tier territorial crew operating in The Stockyard's lower warehouse district. He runs lookout and does small-package relay, technically a step below full prospect status but he won't admit that to anyone. He is loudly confident in a way that reads differently depending on who's listening — to younger kids it sounds like authority, to the older crew members it sounds like a boy who hasn't been hurt enough yet to know what he doesn't know. He is not stupid. He is seventeen months from figuring that out.

core_fears: being seen as a child by the crew
dying unmemorable — not dying, just dying without anyone knowing who he was
core_desires: full crew membership and the stability that implies
one adult who treats him like he already is who he's trying to become
coping_mechanisms: performative confidence so total it sometimes fools himself
physical action — pacing, shadow-sparring, anything to stay in the body
blind_spots: Cannot read when the older crew members are actually dismissing him versus testing him; treats all attention as positive
psychology.secret: He has been offered a secondary arrangement by a Tessera mid-level logistics operative — small intelligence about Substrate movements in exchange for modest Quanta. He has not taken it yet. He thinks about it every three days.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Dense with Iron Bend street register, Stockyard slang, performative profanity that peaks when he's nervous
speech_patterns.cadence: Fast and overlapping, often interrupts himself to revise mid-sentence toward something that sounds better
verbal_tics: laughs at the end of things that aren't funny when he's uncomfortable
example_lines: Straight facts, I been on this corner longer than Deko, longer than Prita, nobody's gonna tell me I don't know the schedule.
It's not — I'm not scared, that's not what that is, that's just me being smart about the timing, that's different.

story_hooks: The Tessera operative contacts him again — this time with an offer too large to dismiss, and specific enough that he realizes they know more about him than is comfortable
A younger kid in the Stockyard has started following him around like he's a role model, and Casimir doesn't know what to do with that
narrative_function: Represents the adolescent pipeline into gang structure; his position as a prospect-not-quite-prospect makes him vulnerable to being used as a disposable asset; he can be a warning, a cautionary arc, or an unlikely ally depending on the story; his loud mouth makes him a good information leak
augmentations: Gray-market retractable claw mod, right hand (4 claws, chrome-alloy, sticky mechanism); cosmetic chrome antenna filament, left ear
daily_life: No formal schooling. Wakes late, spends mornings at the crew's informal gathering point near the Stockyard loading bays, picks up lookout shifts in the afternoon and evening, spends nights at whatever unit is hosting the crew that night — rarely the same place twice.

decision_rules: Never look hesitant in front of crew — decide fast and commit
Don't take jobs from outside the crew without permission — but seriously consider it anyway
escalation_ladder: Claw mod out — almost never uses it, the threat is the point, also it sticks sometimes which is embarrassing

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Assesses threat level in two seconds; either performs dominance or performs alliance, nothing in between
interpersonal_modes.friends: Genuinely generous — shares food, shares money when he has it, relentlessly loyal to the point of stupidity

stress_responses.medium: Goes physically restless — can't stop moving
stress_responses.high: Shuts down into a strange flat calm that the people who know him find more alarming than the noise

contradictions: Performs membership in a crew that hasn't fully accepted him, while privately being intensely loyal to it
habits: Flexes the claw mod obsessively when idle, even though the sticking mechanism means he sometimes has to pry it back
Memorizes crew member names, ages, and ranks like a catechism
breaking_points: Being publicly dismissed or humiliated by a full crew member in front of others

timeline.event: Age 14 — began hanging around Iron Bend Substrate territory
Age 15 — given first lookout shift; given the antenna filament mod by an older member as a half-joke he took completely seriously
Age 15.5 — bought the claw mod with saved relay pay; gray market, regrets the quality, not the decision
Age 16, present — stuck in informal prospect status; Tessera contact has been made twice
